name: player_pending_contact_select_preferred
description: PlayerPendingContact::SelectPreferred chooses which pending collision contact should be resolved first from the horizontal approach-dot score.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player pending-contact source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x424010 validates the ECX/EDX fastcall member ABI, score calculation from (sweepEnd - hitPos).x/z dotted with surfaceNormal.x/z for both contacts, y components ignored after temporary delta construction, and rhs returned on equal scores.
The native smoke verifies rhs selection for the lower approach score, self selection for the lower approach score, and rhs tie behavior.
